reason: A sidebar visualization plugin that aggregates local DSH session token usage into total and per-project cost estimates using refreshed DeepSeek pricing.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中展示总花费、项目花费、Token 明细及 DeepSeek 官方人民币价格，并根据会话日志自动更新统计。
summaries.en: Displays total and per-project costs, token usage details, and DeepSeek pricing in the DSH sidebar based on session logs.

capabilities: Reads local session logs and token usage data for cost calculation
Fetches DeepSeek pricing data from the official pricing page
Displays aggregated project costs and token usage in a sidebar widget
Automatically refreshes pricing and restores the widget after restart
